about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. 1.6.0 scope completion: adds the two facilitator checks F13 (XC-49, asset substitution) and F14 (XC-50, network substitution) built from a public reviewer's comment, and amends the 1.6.0 release task XC-48 to depend on them so they are bound to the v1.6.0 tag. Nothing here is binding until merged into proofline.json and signed. Each XC-49/XC-50 criterion fails on the base commit and passes at the commit that adds the check; the XC-48 amendment only extends its depends_on.

tasks.title: F13: a payment whose asset differs from the requirement's asset is rejected (asset substitution)
tasks.description: A payment that carries the same amount to the same recipient but settles a different mint is a distinct payment, not the one the route quoted. A verifier that compares only amount and payTo lets the wrong asset through. F13 drives the facilitator with a payment whose on-chain asset differs from the requirement's asset and requires a fail-closed rejection; the faulty double trust_asset takes the asset from the requirement on trust and is caught. V2 5.1.2.

criteria.statement: The reference facilitator rejects a payment in a different mint at the same amount and recipient (asset substitution)
F13 catches a facilitator (trust_asset) that takes the paid asset from the requirement on trust
The full offline suite, including every F1-F12 case, passes unchanged

tasks.title: F14: a payment authorized for another network is rejected (facilitator-layer network substitution)
tasks.description: A payment authorized for one network, presented against a requirement on another at the same amount, recipient and asset, is a network substitution. A verifier that takes the network from the requirement on trust lets it through. F14 drives the facilitator with a payment carrying a different authorized network and requires a fail-closed rejection; the faulty double trust_network takes the network from the requirement on trust and is caught. This closes the facilitator-layer network-substitution gap: the payment stand-in previously carried no network at all. The deeper cross-chain-signature replay, where an EIP-3009 domain omits chainId so one signature is valid on several chains, needs a live signature and is tracked separately, out of the offline doubles' reach. V2 5.1.2 and 11.1.

criteria.statement: The reference facilitator rejects a payment authorized for another network at the same amount, recipient and asset (cross-chain replay)
F14 catches a facilitator (trust_network) that takes the authorization's network from the requirement on trust
The full offline suite, including every F1-F12 case, passes unchanged

tasks.title: Release 1.6.0: the rest of the v1.5 build list
tasks.description: As XC-31, for 1.6.0: versions, changelog, corpus-v1.6, once the eight tasks that 1.5.0 shipped without are done: R15 to R19 (XC-18), the implementation matrix (XC-19), the R20 corpus case (XC-22), the n-replica Lean models (XC-24), the framework quickstarts (XC-26), docs examples run by CI (XC-27), the compatibility matrix (XC-28) and the mutation matrix with the false-positive register (XC-29). Publishing stays with the owner.

criteria.statement: Every version string is 1.6.0 in the tree of tag v1.6.0
Tags v1.6.0 and corpus-v1.6 are on origin (pushed by the owner)

verifier.cmd: git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin refs/tags/v1.6.0 refs/tags/corpus-v1.6 | test $(wc -l) -eq 2

criteria.statement: Every changed file is inside this task's scope
The interdependency map is current and the docs match the code
CHANGELOG's 1.6.0 section names every check it adds (R17, R18, R19) and every task it closes (XC-18, XC-19, XC-22, XC-24, XC-26 to XC-29)

verifier.cmd: python3 -c "import re,sys;s=open('CHANGELOG.md').read();i=s.find('\n## 1.6.0');assert i>=0,'no 1.6.0 section';j=s.find('\n## ',i+1);t=s[i:j if j>0 else len(s)];m=[c for c in 'R17 R18 R19 XC-18 XC-19 XC-22 XC-24 XC-26 XC-27 XC-28 XC-29'.split() if not re.search('(?<![A-Za-z0-9])'+c+'(?![0-9a-z])',t)];print(m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)"

criteria.statement: docs/RELEASES.md has a 1.6.0 section naming every check it adds (R17, R18, R19) and every task it closes (XC-18, XC-19, XC-22, XC-24, XC-26 to XC-29)

verifier.cmd: python3 -c "import re,sys;s=open('docs/RELEASES.md').read();i=s.find('\n## 1.6.0');assert i>=0,'no 1.6.0 section';j=s.find('\n## ',i+1);t=s[i:j if j>0 else len(s)];m=[c for c in 'R17 R18 R19 XC-18 XC-19 XC-22 XC-24 XC-26 XC-27 XC-28 XC-29'.split() if not re.search('(?<![A-Za-z0-9])'+c+'(?![0-9a-z])',t)];print(m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)"
python3 -c "import re,sys;s=open('README.md').read();t=s;m=[c for c in 'R17 R18 R19'.split() if not re.search('(?<![A-Za-z0-9])'+c+'(?![0-9a-z])',t)];print(m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)"

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.
